'''Kaito Ishikawa''' (Japanese: '''石川界人''' ''Ishikawa Kaito'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.  

==Biography==
Ishikawa was born October 13, 1994 in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}} and became a voice actor as an adult. Ishikawa's best known roles in the {{pkmn|animated series}} were during {{aniseries|SM}}, during which he voiced {{an|Kiawe}}, one of {{ashcl|Ash's classmates}}, and [[Officer Jenny's Gumshoos]]. Ishikawa is currently affiliated with {{wp|Pro-Fit}}.
